profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company headquartered in Guangzhou. It is a public company traded under the ticker PONY, and its SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001969302. Its website is pony.ai.

According to the company, it was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and now operates three business units: Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicles (POV). It describes its core technology as a "virtual driver" and says it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous vehicles in multiple locations worldwide. The company states that its autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that it has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. It describes itself as pursuing safe, sustainable, and accessible mobility globally and as an industry leader in the commercialization of autonomous driving.

No litigation, MCP servers, or tracked products are recorded for the company.
